title: Replay protection skipped for cached-key hits
description: inbox.rs:576-584. When signature verification succeeds via the cached key (fast path), verify_and_fetch_actor returns early at line 584 — completely skipping the replay detection logic at lines 602-616. An attacker who replays a legitimately signed request within the Date freshness window (±5 min) will bypass replay protection as long as the remote actor's key is already cached. The replay check should run unconditionally before the final return.
